subject.title: [Bug]: Google vertex is now called Google Enterprise AI

question: What exact user-facing label should OpenClaw show for the existing `google-vertex` provider?
rationale: Source inspection confirms the current label is outdated, but the issue's proposed wording differs from current Google docs and a broader provider rename would affect compatibility-sensitive ids.

options.title: Use Google-docs bridge label
options.body: Set visible copy to `Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (Vertex AI)` or very close wording while keeping `google-vertex` stable.

options.title: Use shorter Enterprise label
options.body: Adopt a shorter `Google Enterprise AI` style label, accepting that it diverges from the official docs checked.

options.title: Keep Vertex AI for now
options.body: Leave the current label until Google API/docs wording settles further or OpenClaw plans a broader provider naming pass.

recommendation.title: Use Google-docs bridge label
recommendation.body: Set visible copy to `Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (Vertex AI)` or very close wording while keeping `google-vertex` stable.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining blocker is a UI/docs label decision, and the issue discussion plus recent UI/docs history point there most directly.
